hypothesis: A gradient-trained probabilistic posterior over latent source reliability, explicitly updated after first paid observation, can improve future typed-decision accuracy and predictive logloss over a strong public-polarity Bayesian and empirical conditional Brier baseline under unfamiliar sensor mechanisms.
source: Distinct synthetic development calibration mechanism: two latent mode-dependent reliabilities, observable source polarity, novel noise and skew, private mode and truth held evaluator-only. Fair models share public labeled anchor calibration; two actual target purchases per descriptor.
model: Train-only gradient logistic latent-mode posterior with calibration conditioning, source trustworthiness inferred from public reference. Action selects second purchased channel using posterior expected predictive quality. No hardcoded access to hidden mode.
